name: session
description: Session modes for the main Claude Code session, a base injected at every session start by a SessionStart hook (forks, launch forms, cache and wait rules, models, efforts, roles, intelligence up/downscale), then one user-invocable skill per mode: pipeline (a staged pipeline: ledger, decision contract, verification harness, implementation, closure check, report, cost ledger), review (verification-first review of an MR), codex (codex models luna/terra/sol/astra on base fork jobs and on pipeline or review stages), ask (questions without blocking), and the unstable worker pool (pool-workflow, pool, pool-stop). README.md holds the whole reference: cache facts, compact prices, measurements.
